title: Day plan (N tasks, one per fresh session)
description: Written by the morning planner; validated by a predicate script before the run counts as a success; read by the slot runner and the dashboard. Field names are generic here; map them to your tracker, repositories and model tiers.

fence.description: Usage-fence decision the runner recorded before starting.

instrument.description: Validity of last night's test signal; anything but ok becomes the first item.

on_the_line.description: Apps under the standing rule: repair or ticketed waiver only.

from_human.description: One line per note the human left in the dashboard: what it asked, what the plan did about it.

lessons_applied.description: One line per lesson from yesterday's review that shaped this plan.

ticket_draft.description: Filled when no ticket exists; the human approves, the runner creates it.

model.description: One of your allowed model tiers, for example strongest / strong coder / fast.

est_minutes.description: Estimated wall clock of the session; must fit one slot; compared with the measured actual by the end-of-day review.

est_tokens_k.description: Estimated work tokens in thousands (fresh input + cache writes + output; cache reads excluded), at most the session token budget the runner publishes. Compared with the measured actual.

estimate_basis.description: One line: what the two estimates rest on and which calibration ratio was applied.

pair_candidate.description: True when the estimate is small enough (about 30 minutes and 30% of the token budget) that two such items could share one session later.

premise.description: Refuted premises never enter items; they are listed under refuted.

source.description: The live thing checked this run: file and line, PR number and state, test row, ticket comment date.
